gaps.sentence: The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.

gaps.sentence: The scientists carried ___ a series of experiments.
gaps.explanation: carry out = perform, conduct (research, a plan, an order).

gaps.sentence: The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: The concert tickets sold ___ within an hour.
gaps.explanation: sell out = all tickets/goods are sold.

gaps.sentence: Sales figures have tailed ___ since the summer.
They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.

gaps.sentence: Could you look ___ my suitcase while I buy the tickets?
gaps.explanation: look after = take care of; look for = search; look up = check in a reference.
